description: Compare two or more models side-by-side across pricing and capability dimensions. Useful for routing decisions. Every plan gets each model's current prices, capability ratings (with per-rating notes), static profile fields (creator, architecture, release date, generation), a comparison_url deep link to the rendered comparison on the web, and data-derived routing_hints. Pro and internal keys additionally get: unit-matched price deltas and spread across every compared model (price_comparison), a per-dimension capability rating diff that marks 'unverifiable' rather than silently comparing a real rating against nothing (capability_diff), and price-stability history — age, cut/raise, magnitude — per model (price_stability), where each row names its offering slug and lists any scheduled price changes that haven't taken effect yet (upcoming_changes: UTC effective instant, new price, % change vs current, days until, source). Free/App/Starter responses omit these three fields entirely rather than returning them empty; upgrade at https://modelglass.com.au/signup for the extended comparison.

model_ids.description: Two to ten model ids to compare.

name: modelglass_compare_models

capability_diff.description: Pro/internal only — absent entirely below that tier.

rating.description: A rating value, or 'unverifiable' if no comparable data exists.

comparison_url.description: Deep link to the rendered comparison on the web — the arena page for the first model, with the rest pre-selected via ?vs= (the page shows the base plus up to 3 same-vertical models).

architecture.description: Human architecture label (vocabulary term for knowledge.architecture.type, or the raw type).

notes.description: Model-specific note on this rating, when set (matches the web /compare page's hover text).

context_window.description: LLM-vertical field; absent on modalities that don't have one.

creator.description: Static descriptive field, visible on every plan, absent when unset.

current_credit_prices.description: Current prices in the provider's own credits (e.g. Luma API credits) for tiers with no published USD rate. Not USD: what a credit costs depends on your plan or contract. Absent when there are none.

credit_name.description: Always show it with the figure, e.g. "14 Luma API credits / image".

changes_on.description: Set when a better change (price drop, launch) is held back a day: the provider's date. The new price shows from the next UTC day.

from_provider_date.description: Set when a worse change (price rise, promo end) is shown a day early: the provider's date it starts.

shuts_down_on.description: Set on this tier's last listed day: the provider's shutdown date. It may already be unavailable.

generation.description: Whether this is the current generation in its family or a prior one.

price_note.description: Set when the model has no current USD price but a credit price, e.g. "Priced in Luma API credits; the USD rate depends on your plan or contract."

price_stability.description: Pro/internal only — absent below that tier.

age_days.description: Days since effective_from: the age of the current price row.

stable_since.description: The date this amount has applied since without a break. A row that only re-cites a new source at the same price doesn't restart it, so it can be earlier than effective_from. Computed within the caller's pricing-history window.

offering.description: Offering slug; tells apart two offerings from one provider that share tier ids.

upcoming_changes.description: Scheduled price rows in this tier that haven't taken effect yet, sorted by date. Omitted when nothing is scheduled.

effective_from.description: UTC instant the row takes effect here (00:00 UTC on the day it's first served: a worse change a day early, a better one a day late).

pct_change.description: Change vs the current amount, in percent; null across region/currency/unit.

provider_date.description: The provider's own date for the change; set only when it differs from effective_from's date.

released.description: Release date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), when the model record sets one.

price_comparison.description: Pro/internal only — absent entirely below that tier.

not_comparable.description: Compared models with no current USD price but a credit price (e.g. Luma API credits), with the reason. Absent when there are none.
